note: Ps103 'Bless the LORD, O my soul' (22v). Passages: bless the LORD who forgives/heals/redeems/crowns/satisfies v1-5; his righteousness, merciful+gracious+slow to anger, love toward those who fear him, he knows we are dust v6-14; man like grass, but his love everlasting on those who fear+keep covenant v15-18; his throne, let angels/hosts/works bless him v19-22. IB: the SOUL exhorting itself to BLESS (x3) + not FORGET; the INIQUITY/SINS/TRANSGRESSIONS forgiven; the OPPRESSED; those who FEAR (x3); a father's COMPASSION; our FRAME he knows; those who KEEP covenant + REMEMBER to obey. God's forgive/heal/redeem/crown/merciful/slow-to-anger/steadfast-love = qualifiers; grass/flower transience + the angels/hosts/works who bless (celestial, not human IB) = standalone.
